description: This file defines a Java class 'FilterClassAdapter' that extends ASM's ClassVisitor to filter out fields, methods, and inner classes based on access modifiers and user-defined filtering criteria. It is used during class file analysis or transformation to include or exclude certain class members.

classes.name: FilterClassAdapter
classes.description: A class visitor that filters out class members (fields, methods, inner classes) based on access modifiers and a filter criteria.

methods.name: FilterClassAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FilterClassAdapter with a writer, filter, and logger.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Visits class header information such as version, access, name, signature, superName, and interfaces.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of class visitation.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Visits a class field; filters out non-public/protected fields and those filtered out by the user filter.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Visits a class method; filters out non-public/protected methods and those rejected by the filter (including by signature).

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Visits annotations on classes, fields, or methods.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Handles class attributes, passes through in this implementation.

methods.name: visitInnerClass
methods.description: Visits an inner class; filters based on access modifiers and filter criteria.

methods.name: visitOuterClass
methods.description: Handles outer class visits; in this implementation, no action.

methods.name: visitSource
methods.description: Handles source information; in this implementation, no action.
